kamloops.title: Residents of Kamloops neighbourhood raise safety concerns about proposed rail yard
kamloops.description: The business arm of the Tk̓emlúps te Secwépemc community has asked the City of Kamloops to support a proposal for a rail staging and storage facility. But locals say they're already struggling with increasingly busy train crossings at the only points of access in and out of the community.

southeast.title: Proposed substation in Vancouver's West End faces community opposition
southeast.description: An aging B.C. Hydro substation in Downtown Vancouver must be replaced, though some West End residents are against the proposed location of its successor.
